name: How To Dress
overview: Scripture instructs believers to dress in a manner that honors God by maintaining clear distinctions between genders and avoiding attire associated with immorality or deceit, as seen in Deuteronomy 22:5 and Proverbs 7:10. True beauty is found in a reverent fear of the Lord rather than outward appearance (Proverbs 31:30), and believers are called to present their bodies as holy and acceptable sacrifices to God (Romans 12:1). This includes dressing modestly and respectfully, especially when attending church, to avoid provoking lustful thoughts as warned in Matthew 5:28.
